mapper.select: SELECT TO_CHAR(starts_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS starts_on, TO_CHAR(ends_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ends_on, career_months, granted_days FROM leave_cycle WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND employee_id = #{employeeId} AND starts_on <= TO_DATE(#{today}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ends_on > TO_DATE(#{today}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ORDER BY starts_on DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
mapper.sql: FROM approval_document ad JOIN leave_request_day d ON d.approval_document_id = ad.approval_document_id AND d.company_id = ad.company_id WHERE ad.company_id = #{companyId} AND ad.author_employee_id = #{employeeId} AND ad.document_type = 'DOC_LEAVE'
mapper.select:
SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN ad.status_code = 'APPROVED' THEN d.deduct_days END), 0) AS used_days, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN ad.status_code = 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN d.deduct_days END), 0) AS pending_days
AND ad.status_code IN ('APPROVED', 'IN_PROGRESS') AND d.leave_date >= TO_DATE(#{startsOn}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND d.leave_date < TO_DATE(#{endsOn}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')

SELECT ad.approval_document_id, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT d.leave_type) = 1 THEN MAX(d.leave_type) ELSE 'LV_FULL' END AS leave_type, TO_CHAR(MIN(d.leave_date), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS from_date, TO_CHAR(MAX(d.leave_date), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS to_date, lr.requested_days AS days, lr.reason, TO_CHAR(ad.submitted_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS submitted_at, ad.status_code FROM approval_document ad JOIN leave_request lr ON lr.approval_document_id = ad.approval_document_id AND lr.company_id = ad.company_id JOIN leave_request_day d ON d.approval_document_id = ad.approval_document_id AND d.company_id = ad.company_id WHERE ad.company_id = #{companyId} AND ad.author_employee_id = #{employeeId} AND ad.document_type = 'DOC_LEAVE' AND ad.status_code IN ('IN_PROGRESS', 'APPROVED', 'REJECTED') GROUP BY ad.approval_document_id, lr.requested_days, lr.reason, ad.submitted_at, ad.status_code HAVING MAX(d.leave_date) >= TO_DATE(#{startsOn}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND MIN(d.leave_date) < TO_DATE(#{endsOn}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ORDER BY MIN(d.leave_date) DESC

SELECT s.approval_document_id, s.step_no, e.employee_name AS approver_name, s.status_code, s.opinion FROM approval_step s JOIN employee e ON e.employee_id = s.approver_employee_id AND e.company_id = s.company_id WHERE s.company_id = #{companyId} AND s.approval_document_id IN #{id} ORDER BY s.approval_document_id, s.step_no
